popCulture.title: Telegony
popCulture.description: The lost cyclic sequel is Telegonus' stage — the stingray spear, the unrecognized father, and the voyage back to Circe's island.

popCulture.title: Circe
popCulture.creator: Madeline Miller
popCulture.description: Miller's Circe raises Telegonus on Aeaea — the boy who will sail for Ithaca and change every fate he finds there.
